house.name: Games & Beyond
house.keeper: One front door. Many sovereign game rooms. Platform bodies keep their governing achievement.

bodies.name: RouteOS
bodies.type: Gaming platform / console OS / cartridge ecosystem
bodies.governing_role: Flagship JM console-platform body with cartridge standard and First-Party SDK

bodies.name: GlyphPlay
bodies.governing_role: JM game-authoring and playable-expression engine; cartridge-producing bridge into RouteOS

bodies.name: GameForge
bodies.governing_role: Game construction, arena and creator-export engine with RouteOS cartridge-production relationship

bodies.name: GlyphForge
bodies.governing_role: Asset, glyph and visual-body production route supporting sovereign game bodies

bodies.name: PLAYFORM
bodies.governing_role: Distinct playable-expression framework preserved as a sister system rather than flattened into another engine

bodies.name: T-Boys / Core Clash
bodies.governing_role: Main active game/world body carrying SplitShadow, Let's Go and LightLites ancestry without erasing those sources

bodies.name: JM GameCore
bodies.governing_role: Transforms RouteOS world modules through KicPlay input, GameForge physics, Cading tokens and TraceBox routes
